2609.30971.title: SciHorizon-eLab: An Agentic Protocol-to-Task Compiler for Scalable Benchmarking of Scientific Embodied Agents
2609.30971.paper_summary: Embodied agents offer a promising route to automating scientific experimentation, yet their progress is constrained by the lack of reliable and systematic evaluation environments. Existing simulation-based laboratory benchmarks rely heavily on manual task engineering, making it challenging to systematically compile diverse scientific protocols into executable and verifiable embodied tasks at scale. To address this challenge, we introduce SciHorizon-eLab, an agentic protocol-to-task compiler that formulates scientific embodied task construction as a compilation problem. Given a natural-language protocol of scientific experiments, SciHorizon-eLab progressively compiles laboratory protocols into semantic-preserving embodied tasks through semantic grounding, executable task synthesis, and multi-stage simulation-based certification. The system generates semantically grounded environments, executable manipulation programs, and step-level success specifications, while enabling reproducible generation of expert demonstrations and execution traces. Using this pipeline, we further construct \BenchName, a ready-to-use benchmark comprising 300 certified tasks across diverse laboratory operations. It supports HIL task execution, reproducible expert-demonstration generation, and ordered step-level evaluation. Across representative tasks, the strongest policy attains an average success rate of only 49.7%, with further evaluations revealing pronounced weaknesses in human and embodied agent coordination. We publicly release the code, benchmark data, and evaluation toolkit at https://github.com/SciHorizon-elab/SciHorizon-elab.
2609.30971.paper_summary_zh: 具身代理提供了一條自動化科學實驗的有前景途徑，但其進展受到缺乏可靠且系統化評估環境的限制。現有的基於模擬的實驗室基準在很大程度上依賴於手動任務工程，使得系統性地將多樣的科學協議編纂成可執行且可驗證的具身任務變得具有挑戰性。為了解決這一挑戰，我們介紹了SciHorizon-eLab，一個代理協議到任務的編譯器，將科學具身任務的構建形式化為編譯問題。給定一個自然語言的科學實驗協議，SciHorizon-eLab通過語義基礎、可執行任務合成和多階段基於模擬的認證，逐步將實驗室協議編譯成保留語義的具身任務。該系統生成語義基礎的環境、可執行的操作程序和步驟級成功規範，同時支持可重複生成專家演示和執行痕跡。通過這一管道，我們進一步構建了\BenchName，一個包含300個經過認證的任務的即用型基準，涵蓋多樣的實驗室操作。它支持HIL任務執行、可重複的專家演示生成和有序的步驟級評估。在代表性任務中，最強的策略僅達到49.7%的平均成功率，進一步評估顯示出人類與具身代理協調方面的明顯弱點。我們在https://github.com/SciHorizon-elab/SciHorizon-elab公開發布了代碼、基準數據和評估工具包。
